natural_language_triggers: スレッドオーケストレーション
manage Coding Agents in separate tasks

routing.primary_route: Use $control-codex-sessions with the codex_session_control_plane MCP ledger and the native codex_app task-tool family. Prepare each call in the ledger, execute it in the active controller, then record its normalized outcome.
fallback_conditions: If a core native task tool is absent, report its exact name and offer ordinary official subagents or a configured custom agent only when in-task delegation still satisfies the goal.
If live creation is not currently authorized, return a dry-run topology and do not invoke a native mutation.
non_use_conditions: Do not use for ordinary official subagent delegation inside one Codex task.
Do not create a new visible task unless the current user explicitly requested it.
Do not treat the MCP server, dashboard, plugin cache, runtime ledger, or task history as the native executor or editable source.

trigger_phrases: Codexの画面に別スレッドを作る
run Coding Agents in each task

rules.description: A first-time Codex reader uses an explicit install-only AGENTS route, a canonical personal-plugin source, a preserving marketplace update, and the official Codex plugin CLI without editing runtime cache.
Only the native codex_app task tools own real visible task operations; the MCP server prepares and records calls.
Project discovery, create, list, wait, read, send, fork, handoff/status, title, pin, archive, and navigation are represented in the public and executable contracts.
A dry-run is the default; live native mutations require current explicit user authority and per-call control-plane confirmation.
Launch selects one exact local project path, defaults Git to worktree and non-Git to local, and accepts model/thinking overrides only with user_request authority.

A queued create retains clientThreadId as provenance while executable source binds one schemaVersion 4 entry using the complete leading marker plus exact selected projectId and absolute runtime cwd for worktrees, or exact declared cwd for local launches; runtime cwd is recorded separately and fabricated or ambiguous evidence is rejected.
Normalized native observations move worker state to review; only a controller decision completes a task and run.
A Coding Agents workflow stays inside its visible worker project/worktree and does not become a sibling-task controller.
Without a native stop tool, the ledger records cancellation intent and reports the required user stop rather than claiming interruption.
Ledger writes are serialized and persisted through a private temporary file, sync, and atomic rename.
The dashboard binds only to loopback, protects mutations with a process token, limits request bodies, and applies a restrictive content security policy.
The dashboard provides persistent Japanese, English, and System language selection plus Light, Dark, and System theme selection.
